summary: Israeli forces conducted strikes on Hezbollah infrastructure in southern Lebanon, targeting areas including Jjaya, Bayya'in, and Ras al-Shit. Hamas operative Muhammad Na'im Jandiya, involved in the October 7 attacks and hostage holding, was killed in northern Gaza. Iranian funeral processions for Ayatollah Khamenei's son-in-law drew thousands in Tehran amid rising rhetoric from Iranian officials about potential responses to unmet agreements.

Israeli strikes on Hezbollah infrastructure and Iranian aircraft suggest increased cross-border operations. Hamas operatives' elimination in Gaza reduces immediate threats but may prompt retaliatory actions. Iranian rhetoric about unmet agreements signals readiness for military responses. Saudi interception of Iranian aircraft highlights growing Gulf state involvement in regional security dynamics.
